title: Non-disruptive canary orchestration with phased ingress and tenant-specific routing controls
creator: Alex Kim
description: Goal: implement a conservative, non-disruptive canary orchestration flow that supports phased ingress percentages, tenant/namespace-scoped routing rules, and an environment-aware admission controller. The feature must work across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments while respecting configuration constraints (network egress, per-tenant firewalling, and audit/KMS policies).
acceptance_criteria: Console UI: ability to create a phased canary policy with stage definitions (percent, duration, health gates) and per-tenant routing overrides.
Runtime: admission controller enforces environment constraints and rejects configurations that require unsupported primitives (e.g., cross-VPC traffic mirroring when Private tenant denies mirroring).
Traffic phasing: traffic percentages applied gradually (0 -> X -> Y -> 100) and can be paused/resumed via API or Console.

Auto-rollback: automatic rollback triggers on defined SLO regressions (latency p95 up 30% vs baseline, error rate > threshold) with a configurable cool-down window. Rollback produces a deterministic audit trail and notifies configured channels.
A/B and canary parity: the same policy model can express both canary and A/B experiments; we can compute exposure metrics and route-by-header or route-by-tenant.
Integration tests: e2e tests exercising Hosted, Dedicated (multi-GPU pool), and Private (VPC-only) simulation runs with mocked network constraints.
comments: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting with PM and Design. Agreed to prioritize non-disruptive safety over frictionless UX for initial rollout.
2026-02-22: Design feedback (from Maya Lopez): prefer explicit stage durations rather than percent-only ramps; added optional hold step for manual verification.

2026-02-28: Engineering spike completed. Prototype admission controller using policy engine that checks 'canMirrorTraffic' and 'externalEgressAllowed' flags per environment. Repo: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-rollout-proto PR #312.
2026-03-03: Security review onboarding: need KMS audit on rollout changes for Private tenants. Filed follow-up task to integrate KMS logging with rollout events.
2026-03-07: Implementation: added baseline computation job to Console metrics pipeline. Baseline computed from last 7 days by default; configurable per-policy.

2026-03-10: QA note: discovered flake where Dedicated autoscaler and phased ingress interact causing cold-start latency spikes at stage boundaries. Mitigation plan: pre-warm nodes + staggered token bucket release.
